Chapter 6767: Three-Treasure Dragon

Chapter 6767: Three-treasure Dragon

Beasts and men kneeled on the ground. When they looked up, they saw an auspicious dragon exuding three treasured lights. The draconic lights reminded them it was time to tremble in fear.

“Three-treasure Dragon.” They knew of its type.

“Dragon Ancestor!” They also saw the dragon rider - a peerless beauty in a pale yellow robe, accentuating both her slender waist and proud curves. Her complexion was as fair as frost.

She possessed an authoritative and noble air. Her eyes, though breathtakingly beautiful, were imposing. None dared to stare at her for too long.

She sat in the meditative pose on the dragon, seemingly eternal and in charge of all lives.

“Dragon Ancestor has arrived!” Cultivators immediately kowtowed in reverence, feeling a sense of awe greater than when they had witnessed Tiger Ancestor.

She was the lord of Yellow Sky and the master of a three-treasure dragon. The progenitor of this sect, Yellow Sky, had become a divine beastmaster, also known as a supreme overlord. She had ascended to another world.

Dragon Ancestor was the strongest ancestor and could almost rival Yudi of Sky Zenith. Others never had the privilege of seeing her, hence their astonishment today.

“Dragon Ancestor.” Tiger Ancestor staggered backward, aware of his inferiority.

“Tiger Ancestor, withdraw.” She spoke softly but left no room for refusal.

“You wish to declare war against Sky Zenith?” His expression soured.

As one of the few ancient ancestors in Sky Zenith, he had the authority to represent the entire sect. Scalps tingled as the crowd thought about the devastating consequences of a potential conflict.

“That’s not up to you, Tiger Ancestor.” A gallant man appeared in the sky.

“Phoenix Emperor!” Everyone became startled again.

“Both Dragon Ancestor and Phoenix Emperor are here.” Eyes shifted between him and the dragon rider.

In Beastmaster World, the three top ancestors included Dragon, Phoenix, and Yudi. Each represented a top lineage.

They had the highest authority and decided Beastmaster’s direction. Now, two were on the scene.

“Phoenix Emperor.” Tiger Ancestor became alarmed again.

Just one Dragon Ancestor was beyond his capability to deal with, now these two could easily kill him.

Normally, the threat of Sky Zenith deterred others but it didn’t work against these two cultivators. Did they want to declare war against Sky Zenith together?

“A war between the three behemoths?” Ancestors shuddered and talked among themselves.

A delicate balance had existed between the three powers for years now. Would Sky Zenith be able to withstand a new alliance?

“Nothing good will come from this, only cries and blood.” A royal ancestor murmured: “How many will be dragged into this mess?”

Meanwhile, Tiger Ancestor slowly retreated, ready for an all-out battle.

However, Phoenix Emperor and Dragon Ancestor ignored him and landed before Li Qiye.

“Immortals, this is Dragon Ancestor that I spoke of.” Phoenix Emperor kneeled.

Jaws dropped to the ground afterward. Tiger Ancestor couldn’t believe his eyes.

Dragon Ancestor stared at Li Qiye and Xiaoyue, feeling confused. Although Phoenix Emperor had told her ahead of time, seeing the duo made her uncertain.
